// 在 0.24.0 的源码导出里跑（README 里"怎么给一个新版本补一份目录"）：用那个版本**自己的真实函数** importRemoteAsset
// 落一张生成图和它的 .meta（里面有服务商的临时链接 originalUrl），输出目录由 V_OUT 给。
// 放到导出里的 electron/assets/zzRefLinkGen.test.ts，去掉 .txt。这里存成 .ts.txt，是为了不被本仓的测试和类型检查收进去。
//
// 假的只有两样：取回（hardenedFetch 换成吐一张真 PNG）和 electron 的目录。落盘、sidecar、预览、素材路径都是 0.24.0 的真函数。
// 地址必须是 http://127.0.0.1:39017（测试每次把它换成随机端口的假服务），没有任何 Key。
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { afterAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { createProject, importRemoteAsset } from "../runtime";

vi.mock("../review/reviewTrace", () => ({ scheduleTechnicalReview: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("./assetEvents", () => ({ broadcastAssetsUpdated: vi.fn(), broadcastAssetLocalizationStarted: vi.fn(async () => {}) }));
const hardenedFetchMock = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());
vi.mock("../hardenedFetch", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import("../hardenedFetch")>()),
  hardenedFetch: hardenedFetchMock,
}));

const roots: string[] = [];
const documents = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "nomi-ref-gen-documents-"));
const userData = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "nomi-ref-gen-user-data-"));
roots.push(documents, userData);
vi.mock("electron", () => ({
  app: { getPath: (name: string) => (name === "documents" ? documents : userData), getAppPath: () => process.cwd() },
}));

afterAll(() => {
  for (const root of roots) fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

const OUT = String(process.env.V_OUT || "").trim();
const SAVED_ORIGIN = "http://127.0.0.1:39017";
const PNG = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "..", "providerAdapter", "__fixtures__", "certification-media", "valid.png"));

describe("zzRefLinkGen", () => {
  it("lands a generated image and its .meta with the release's real importRemoteAsset", async () => {
    expect(OUT, "V_OUT must name the output directory").not.toBe("");
    const rootPath = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "nomi-ref-gen-project-"));
    roots.push(rootPath);
    const project = createProject({ rootPath, name: "Old User Generated", payload: {} });
    hardenedFetchMock.mockResolvedValue({ bytes: PNG, contentType: "image/png", status: 200, finalUrl: `${SAVED_ORIGIN}/generated/gen-ref.png`, truncated: false });
    const asset = await importRemoteAsset({ projectId: project.id, url: `${SAVED_ORIGIN}/generated/gen-ref.png`, expectedKind: "image", fileName: "gen-ref.png", ownerNodeId: "node-1" }) as { data: { relativePath: string; absolutePath: string; contentType: string } };
    const sidecar = `${asset.data.absolutePath}.meta`;
    expect(fs.existsSync(sidecar)).toBe(true);
    const meta = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sidecar, "utf8")) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(meta.originalUrl).toBe(`${SAVED_ORIGIN}/generated/gen-ref.png`);

    const target = path.join(OUT, path.dirname(asset.data.relativePath));
    fs.mkdirSync(target, { recursive: true });
    fs.copyFileSync(asset.data.absolutePath, path.join(OUT, asset.data.relativePath));
    fs.copyFileSync(sidecar, path.join(OUT, `${asset.data.relativePath}.meta`));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, "manifest.json"), `${JSON.stringify({ relativePath: asset.data.relativePath, contentType: asset.data.contentType, savedOrigin: SAVED_ORIGIN }, null, 2)}\n`);
  });
});
